claim_boundary: AI or ML may assist retrieval, triage and drafting only under frozen evidence, deterministic checks and human review. It cannot establish source contribution, causation, compliance, exposure, safety or health effects.

current_execution.reason: The current AQ26 run uses deterministic acquisition, normalisation, quality-control, freshness, linkage and communication rules. Configured AI credentials or catalogue entries do not constitute model execution or scientific evidence.

predeployment: Frozen benchmark datasets containing normal periods, known provider outages and documented pollution episodes.
False-positive, false-negative, calibration, geographic subgroup and data-missingness evaluation.
Adversarial tests for prompt injection, unsupported attribution and prohibited health/compliance claims.
Reproducibility from frozen inputs, code revision, parameters and output schema.
runtime: Record model/provider/version only when a model is actually called.
Hash inputs, templates, parameters and structured outputs.
Require deterministic contract reconciliation and human approval before communication.
Fail closed when provenance, freshness, schema or claim-boundary checks fail.

freshness_diagnostic.claim_boundary: This diagnostic concerns data recency and provider/network timing only. It does not describe air quality, source contribution, compliance, exposure or health risk.
freshness_diagnostic.interpretation: Some reporting sites met the freshness threshold and others did not.

permitted_ai_ml_roles: Suggest source-discovery queries and candidate datasets for human approval.
Assist metadata normalisation and document/entity extraction with deterministic validation against originals.
Rank evidence-review workload using transparent, reproducible features.
Draft bounded summaries that are checked against the frozen public release contract.
Propose anomaly candidates only when deterministic statistical gates independently reproduce them.
prohibited_ai_ml_roles: Causal source attribution or source-apportionment determination.
Permit, legal, regulatory or compliance determination.
Exposure, safety, medical or health-impact determination.
Inventing, repairing or replacing missing measurements.
Granting website, email, social or scientific-publication authority.
Treating model confidence, fluent text or credential availability as validation.

recommended_model_ladder.method: deterministic lateness baselines and change-point alerts by provider, station and pollutant
recommended_model_ladder.minimum_gate: timestamp provenance, stable expected cadence and alert evaluation on historical outages

recommended_model_ladder.method: seasonal robust statistics with multiplicity control, never a single uncalibrated black-box score
recommended_model_ladder.minimum_gate: fresh quality-eligible series, station-role compatibility and out-of-sample false-alert evaluation

recommended_model_ladder.method: distance/time constrained clustering followed by independent meteorology and competing-source checks
recommended_model_ladder.minimum_gate: multiple physical sites, synchronized timestamps and documented spatial uncertainty

recommended_model_ladder.method: schema-constrained extraction with page-level citations, hashes and human verification
recommended_model_ladder.minimum_gate: original authoritative document retained and every extracted field traceable to source location

recommended_model_ladder.method: compare compatible ground observations with CAMS or equivalent model context without treating residuals as attribution
recommended_model_ladder.minimum_gate: unit, averaging period, grid, time and uncertainty compatibility established
